prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1352; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism is consistent with the shoulder complaints documented at intake, and the injury pattern is plausible for a impact of this type. Over the course of 29 visits, care followed a conventional progression, beginning with physical therapy, range-of-motion work, and home exercise instruction, then tapering in frequency as symptoms improved and strength returned. Physical examination revealed limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff insertion, findings that support the clinical diagnosis, while several neurological screens and imaging-independent stability tests returned normal results. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment to this shoulder, and no earlier records addressing this body region were identified in the chart review. Billing reflects one charge per scheduled service, with no duplicate or repeated entries. At discharge the patient had reached a stable functional level with residual mild stiffness, and continued home exercise was recommended.
